faq.question: Q1. What is NIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 is an employment notification inviting applications for temporary project positions of Research Associate-I / JRF and Technical Assistant under a DST-sponsored research project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under NIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies are available, comprising 1 post for Research Associate-I / JRF and 2 posts for Technical Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving applications by email is 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate-I / JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in a relevant area such as Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, or an allied discipline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized University or Institute, with preference given to those with a Science or Engineering background and prior experimental experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Research Associate-I / JRF receives Rs. 58,000/- p.m. + 30% HRA, while Technical Assistant receives Rs. 20,000/- p.m. + 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates must email their filled application format along with self-attested scanned PDF copies of supporting documents to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for NIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of the project positions?
faq.answer: The positions are initially for 1 year, extendable or co-terminus with the project duration up to a maximum of 2 years based on satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the selected candidates be required to work?
faq.answer: Selected candidates may be required to work onsite at NIT Delhi, IIT Jodhpur, or other testing and characterisation facilities as directed by the Principal Investigator.
